title: Image
description: Image file with metadata including dimensions, file size, format, photographer, location, tags, and URLs. Used for image hosting platforms, photo galleries, stock photo sites, and media libraries.

title.description: Title or caption of the image

description.description: Brief description of the image content

url.description: URL to the full-size image file

thumbnail_url.description: URL to a smaller thumbnail version of the image

format.description: Image file format (e.g., jpg, png, gif, webp, svg)

tags.description: Array of tags for categorization and search

photographer.description: Full name of the photographer who took the image

location.description: Location where the image was taken

uploaded_at.description: Timestamp when the image was uploaded
